question: Who among the following was the first chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Radhakrishnan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. S Radhakrishnan** was the **First Chairman of the Rajya Sabha**, as well the First **Vice President** of India.
 
• Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was an **Indian theorist.**
 
• He was popular for his work on **comparative religion, comparative Eastern and Western philosophy, and was also a teacher in India and at Oxford University in the United Kingdom.**
 
• He was proposed **16 times** for the Nobel Prize for his work in** Literature.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8fbf24bcdfcfbd840cf2cae08c3dc512fc61597ca59745cd6201828eccc04e5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajendra Prasad** was the first president of the Republic of India.
 
• **Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar** was an Indian jurist, economist, politician, and social reformer who Chaired the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly and was **India's First Minister for Law and Justice.​ **
 
• **Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha **was the first president of the Constituent meeting.
